info.name: Akhi - Authentication Email-verification Roles Profile Addresses Users

item.name: 0 Setup (run first)
0.1 Health check
0.2 Login admin

exec: if (String(pm.collectionVariables.get("adminEmail")).startsWith("PUT_")) { throw new Error("First open the collection Variables tab and set adminEmail and adminPassword (Current value)."); }

item.name: 1 Registration and email verification (Akhi)
1.1 Register customer 1 - account is created locked, no login token

exec: pm.test("No login token is given yet", () => { pm.expect(body.data.token).to.be.undefined; pm.expect(body.data.user).to.be.undefined; });
pm.test("Sandbox mode gives a link to the test email (MAIL_MODE=sandbox)", () => pm.expect(body.data.sandboxLink).to.match(/verify-email\?token=[a-f0-9]{64}$/));

item.name: 1.2 Register the same email again is rejected
1.3 Register without a password is rejected
1.4 Register with a 5-character password is rejected
1.5 Register with a number as the name is rejected
1.6 Register customer 2 who tries to sneak in role admin (role is ignored)
1.7 Login before verifying is blocked
1.8 Wrong password on an unverified account still says 401 (status is not leaked)
1.9 Verify with a garbage token is rejected
1.10 Verify without a token is rejected
1.11 Verify with a well-formed but unknown token is rejected
1.12 Resend asks for a new link (old link stops working)

exec: pm.test("Link is different from the first one", () => pm.expect(pm.collectionVariables.get("verifyToken")).to.not.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("oldVerifyToken")));

item.name: 1.13 Resend twice within a minute is rate limited
1.14 The OLD link no longer works
1.15 The NEW link verifies the account
1.16 A used link cannot be used again
1.17 Resend for an unknown email gives the same generic answer (no email probing)
1.18 Resend for an already verified account (the admin) sends nothing
1.19 Resend without an email is rejected
1.20 Verify customer 2 (needed for later folders)
2 Login and token (Akhi)
2.1 Verified customer logs in

exec: pm.test("Role is customer and email is verified", () => { pm.expect(body.data.user.role).to.eql("customer"); pm.expect(body.data.user.emailVerified).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 2.2 Wrong password is rejected
2.3 Unknown email gets the same message as a wrong password

exec: pm.test("Message does not reveal which part was wrong", () => pm.expect(body.message).to.eql("Email or password is incorrect."));

item.name: 2.4 Login without a password is rejected
2.5 Login with a number as the email is rejected
2.6 Current user with a valid token
2.7 Current user without a token is rejected
2.8 A fake token is rejected
2.9 Customer 2 logs in
3 Roles and access control (Akhi)
3.1 Customer cannot list users
3.2 No token cannot list users
3.3 Admin lists users: customer 1 is there and customer 2 is only a customer

exec: pm.test("Customer 1 is in the list", () => pm.expect(users.some((u) => u.email === pm.collectionVariables.get("custEmail"))).to.eql(true));
pm.test("Public sign-up cannot make an admin (role stayed customer)", () => pm.expect(c2.role).to.eql("customer"));

item.name: 3.4 Customer cannot create staff accounts
3.5 Customer cannot change roles
3.6 Customer cannot delete users
4 Profile (Akhi)
4.1 Customer reads own profile
4.2 Profile needs a login
4.3 Customer changes name
4.4 Empty name is rejected
4.5 Customer saves a phone number
4.6 A number as the phone is rejected
4.7 Email already used by another account is rejected
4.8 Customer changes email to a new one
4.9 Login works with the new email
5 Saved addresses (Akhi)
5.1 New customer has no saved addresses
5.2 Add the first address (becomes default automatically)
5.3 Address without an address line is rejected
5.4 isDefault must be true or false
5.5 Add a second address as the new default

exec: pm.test("Only ONE default at a time", () => { pm.expect(defaults).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(defaults[0].addressLine).to.eql("Office 5, Gulshan Avenue"); });

item.name: 5.6 Update the second address
5.7 Update with no changes is rejected
5.8 Update an address that does not exist
5.9 Customer 2 cannot edit customer 1's address
5.10 Addresses need a login
5.11 Delete the first address
5.12 Deleting it again gives 404
6 Change password (Akhi)
6.1 Wrong current password is rejected

exec: pm.test("Says current password is incorrect", () => pm.expect(body.message).to.include("Current password is incorrect"));

item.name: 6.2 New password equal to the current one is rejected
6.3 New password shorter than 8 characters is rejected
6.4 Missing fields are rejected
6.5 Change password needs a login
6.6 Correct current password changes it
6.7 The OLD password no longer works
6.8 The NEW password works (it really changed in the database)
7 Admin user management and staff accounts (Akhi)
7.1 Admin creates a delivery partner
7.2 Creating the same email again is rejected
7.3 Staff role must be admin or deliveryPartner
7.4 Staff account without a password is rejected
7.5 The delivery partner can log in right away (staff do not need email verification)
7.6 A delivery partner cannot use admin screens
7.7 Admin edits the delivery partner's details
7.8 A malformed user id is rejected
7.9 An invalid role is rejected
7.10 Admin cannot remove their own admin role
7.11 Admin cannot delete their own account
7.12 Admin promotes customer 2 to delivery partner
7.13 Admin sets customer 2 back to customer
8 Review photo upload access (Akhi)
8.1 Photo upload needs a login
8.2 A non-image body is rejected
8.3 Customers cannot use the admin image upload
9 Cleanup (Akhi)
9.1 Admin deletes customer 1
9.2 Admin deletes customer 2
9.3 Admin deletes the delivery partner
9.4 Deleting a user that is already gone gives 404
9.5 A deleted customer cannot log in any more
